subject.title: fix(plugins): pretag pack checks stop hanging on stalled commands

question: Should plugin pretag runtime-build, npm-pack, and ClawHub-pack commands all fail after a hard ten-minute timeout?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and uses the timeout budget described as analogous to other release checks, but choosing a universal release-preflight deadline changes the behavior for unusually slow valid package operations.

options.title: Accept the uniform ten-minute ceiling
options.body: Merge the shared cutoff if ten minutes is the intended maximum operator budget for every affected pretag stage.

options.title: Use stage-specific policy
options.body: Revise the wrapper so the release owner can set distinct documented limits where runtime builds and package publishing have different expected durations.

recommendation.title: Accept the uniform ten-minute ceiling
recommendation.body: Merge the shared cutoff if ten minutes is the intended maximum operator budget for every affected pretag stage.

likelyOwner.reason: They are best positioned to set the supported duration contract for release-preflight commands.
